svg.aria-label: Reading a big file. Without justless, cat docs/reference.md prints all 1,099 lines (228,160 bytes). With justless, justless read docs/reference.md --outline returns 36 lines (2,367 bytes): the file's revision and line count, then one row per heading with its line range, 34 headings on this first page, and a command for the next page; this picture leaves out the 18 rows from #8 to #25. justless expand docs/reference.md 'cdf9bb99f0171c76663e2065#28' then returns the Failures section, lines 738 to 741, exactly as they are in the file (794 bytes). The outline is 96 times smaller than the file.
svg.title: Before and after justless: reading a big file

### Failures
A body the proxy cannot parse or plan is forwarded unchanged,
and so is a body over 64 MiB, streamed with its declared
length. A body that ends before its `Content-Length`, or a
malformed chunked body, is answered with a 400 and never
forwarded. `--upstream` and `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` cannot carry
credentials in the URL, because the proxy prints and logs it.
When the API rejects the clearing edit itself with a 400 or
422 that names it, the proxy sends the original request once
more, relays that response, and leaves the edit off for that
model until it restarts. Every other response, errors
included, is relayed unchanged and never retried. An
unreachable upstream returns a 502 with an error in the API's
format. Compressed responses are relayed but not counted in
`stats`.
In this example: 1,099 → 36 lines, 228,160 → 2,367 bytes
Then one section, lines 738–741: 794 bytes, exactly as in the file
Gaps mark lines left out of this picture, 18 on the right.
Long lines wrap for display.
# Justless reference
## Commands
| Command | Result |
| `justless run --max-bytes 4096 -- COMMAND ARG…` | Bounded
previews for stdout and stderr, the child exit status (127
or 126 when the command cannot be found or run), and the
run ID. Without `--max-bytes`, each command family's
budget adapts to how often agents replayed its clipped
streams in full. |
| `justless exec --lang python3 --file data.json CODE` |
Runs a short script and returns only what it prints, with
its exit status. The full output keeps a run ID. The code
can also come from stdin (`-`) or `--script FILE`. |
| `justless exec … --intent TEXT` | Replaces stdout longer
than the preview with the lines most relevant to TEXT,
each marked for `justless log` |
| `justless search RUN_ID TEXT` | Literal matches with
stream and line numbers, up to `--limit`, 20 by default.
When the limit cuts, every stream with a match keeps a
place, a failed run's failure lines and stderr come first,
and a last line counts what each stream left out. |
| `justless log RUN_ID --stream stdout --from 10 --to 15` |
Original bytes for the specified inclusive line range,
with secrets replaced by markers. `--unredacted` returns
the exact bytes. Omit the range to replay the complete
stream. |
| `justless query SYMBOL --view VIEW` | Definition,
references, callers, or related tests. Use `all` for the
combined view. |
| `justless query SYMBOL --view dependencies` | Outgoing
calls, imports, and other indexed relationships |
| `justless path FROM TO` | A short relationship chain with
the location and direction of each edge |
… 723 more lines

declared length. A body that ends before its

until it restarts. Every other response, errors included,

upstream returns a 502 with an error in the API's format.
Compressed responses are relayed but not counted in
